issue.title: Diagnose recurring widespread ACE PNG baseline drift
issue.description: Discovered while landing epic sase-d9 on master 624db9a9f; follow-up to canceled broad-drift beads sase-bl, sase-c5, and sase-c6. `just check` passed every static gate and 24,990 tests but failed 307 visual snapshots; a dedicated `just test-visual` run failed 264/401 snapshots. The representative node tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_editor.py::test_axe_generated_instance_warning_png_snapshot reproduces alone with 5,256 changed pixels (4,535 material), so this is not only xdist contention. Diagnose shared baseline/runtime drift and update renderer setup, code, or only confirmed-intentional goldens. The sase-d9 epic hint-mode PNG passes in isolation, so do not attribute the broad drift to clan hints without new evidence.

payload.close_reason: No longer reproducible on master 5143cb981: just test-visual reports 405 passed, 1 skipped, against the reported 264/401 and 307 failing snapshots. The representative node test_axe_generated_instance_warning_png_snapshot passes.

evidence.note: Independent post-close recurrence from landing bead sase-jx on master 4fafb6a8c after just install rebuilt sase-core-rs 0.26.3: 'just test-visual -k axe' failed exactly 11/32 selected cases (21 passed, 1 skipped), all in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_editor.py. Representative constrained-width mismatch changed 4,758/809,216 pixels (4,173 material); the other 10 failures share the same 4,758/4,173-pixel drift signature. The overrun feature's two new PNGs and other AXE cases passed, and the proposing phase sase-jx.4 had independently reproduced the same failures on a clean master tree.

payload.close_reason: Backlog cut to seven (owner-requested, 2026-08-12): real but outside the gates that block agents, and repeatedly resistant to diagnosis. The sase-jx.land +1 is credible (11/32 AXE cases failing with a shared 4,758/4,173-pixel drift signature, reproduced independently by sase-jx.4 on clean master), so this is not being closed as unreproducible. It is being deprioritized: the PNG snapshot suite is excluded from both 'just test' and 'just test-cost', so 'just check' and 'just check-full' are green on it and no landing agent is blocked -- unlike sase-jq and sase-kd, which are red on the flake-baseline gate at HEAD right now. This is also the fourth bead on the same broad-drift symptom (sase-bl, sase-c5, sase-c6 all closed before it) and each round has drifted by a different pixel signature (5,256/4,535 then 4,758/4,173), which points at renderer/font/environment variance across hosts and builds rather than a single fixable regression -- something worth a deliberate scoped investigation into the visual harness's determinism pinning, not a standing task bead that keeps reopening. Reopen with a +1 if the drift ever reaches a gate that blocks landing, or re-file as a plan to make the PNG harness reproducible across builds.
